primary_formula: Average GEN metrics inside TRAIN817; take candidate mean/control mean for each of seven metrics; average those seven ratios forR. R_attr averages L/W/speed ratios. Gates apply to arm means, not whichever GEN repeat performs better.

final_interpretation.short_budget_prediction_risk: Across the four actual matched exposures, R rises.78478→.86440→.89493→.92750; speed ratio changes.47487→.89426→.91123→1.10968 and angle.69136→.82326→1.01660→1.05914. final_interpretation.population_caveat: Generated type determines the evaluated vehicle set. The shared fixed ego position/heading/shape/type contributes to metrics; ego speed remains generated. Histogram differences do not isolate non-ego physical reconstruction, type selection, or individual intervention causes.

optimizer_ema_horizon_limitation.source_rule: torch_ema defaults to use_num_updates=True; InitDiffusion.reset_ema does not override it. Each update increments n first, then uses min(nominal_decay,(1+n)/(10+n)). SMART.optimizer_step calls update_ema after the optimizer step. Actual saved final counts are4096 for new_control and ego_sincos and8192 for combo.
optimizer_ema_horizon_limitation: The4.249epoch endpoints still use adaptive EMA rather than the configured.9999 ceiling. Ceiling values above every adaptive decay in the observed history would produce identical EMA updates; the controller does not run an additional ceiling test before that intervention becomes active.

B256 and B512 have the same2097048sample exposure but different optimizer and EMA update counts. Report both when comparing recipes. The observed joint intervention does not isolate an EMA or batch-size causal mechanism.

The.9999 ceiling first becomes active after89990EMA updates, about93.3506epochs atB512 or46.6753epochs atB256 with this data order. At128epochs both would use the ceiling if the rule stays unchanged. EMA therefore changes regime beyond the quick budget.

A constant-decay approximation such as1/(1-decay) is neither a measured averaging horizon here nor a causal explanation of the metric difference. Earlier decays vary with n; do not report an approximate EMA window as an observed result.
Current actual LR remains about99.77%of initial. The later128epoch cosine schedule and EMA regime are unobserved; these quick points do not support a numerical128epoch forecast.
